title: IntelEngine — NPC Autonomy & Faction Politics
tagline: Give Skyrim’s NPCs agency—tasks, schedules, autonomous stories, and faction politics.
description:
IntelEngine gives Skyrim's NPCs the ability to act autonomously through SkyrimNet. NPCs can travel, deliver messages, fetch or escort people, schedule meetings and tasks, spread gossip, pursue personal storylines, and participate in an evolving faction-politics system.

Originally created by **Galanx**. **PhospheneOverdrive** currently maintains it in the official galanx repositories (IntelEngine-GamePlugin and IntelEngine-NativePlugin), with Galanx's go-ahead.

Release **3.7** is a big Director and dashboard update: an experimental **Generate** button fills Director forms for you, Director requests now confirm or explain a refusal on screen, finished NPC stories and social scenes appear in SkyrimNet's History, and the dashboard can run on **Magelight UI** (recommended; PrismaUI still works as a fallback). It also fixes duplicate arrivals, mod-added NPC IDs and faction-leader matching.

**3.7.1** is a hotfix: the dashboard no longer goes blank with some mod names, a crash near some modded NPCs is fixed, and MCM Hold Restriction toggles now save.

⚠️ **Upgrading from a pre-3.6 save? Convert it before loading with 3.7.x.** Saves already on 3.6.x and fresh games don't need conversion. See the FAQ included in the download for instructions. Windows Defender may flag the bundled converter as a false positive; it is being reported to Microsoft.

3.7.x tested on **Skyrim SE/AE 1.6.1170**. 1.7.104 and **VR 1.4.15 should work** (1.7.104 tested on 3.6; VR partly tested on 3.6). Skyrim 1.5.97 partly tested by users. Use the matching versions of **SKSE and Address Library**.

**Have issues?** Report them on the IntelEngine-GamePlugin GitHub issues page.

**Requires SkyrimNet Beta 27 or newer. Not compatible with Beta 26 or earlier.** Optional: Magelight UI 1.7.1+ for the dashboard.
author: phospheneoverdrive
changelog:
### Fixes
- The dashboard no longer goes blank when a game or mod name has invalid text encoding; it shows � instead.
- Fixed a crash near some modded NPCs whose faction list contains a non-faction record; the NPC is logged once so the mod can be found.
- MCM Hold Restriction toggles now save when clicked (the dashboard Settings tab already worked).

This release updates `IntelEngine.dll` and the MCM script; install the whole package over 3.7.0.

Full changelog: https://github.com/galanx/IntelEngine-GamePlugin/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#371--2026-11-04
Download: https://github.com/galanx/IntelEngine-GamePlugin/releases/tag/v3.7.1
